title: Recitation
description: Upload audio for timestamped transcription and pace analysis
referencePlaceholder: Paste a reference to align the transcript
noAccuracy: No reference supplied; accuracy was not calculated
engineHint: Local transcription requires a Windows speech language pack. Other models must support the audio transcription endpoint. DeepSeek chat APIs do not provide audio transcription.
repetitionUnknown: Recitation count is unknown; one recording does not establish multiple recitations
confidenceUnknown: The engine did not provide confidence
alignmentTooLong: Reference exceeds 5,000 characters; split it before analysis
playbackFailed: Cannot play or seek audio; check the file and system codecs
extractionHint: Paragraphs, keywords, and exercises are extracted locally from the transcript. Verify low-confidence passages first. Reference matching compares text and cannot replace human assessment.
recallPrompt: Recall and repeat the passage beginning with “{text}”.

planActions.verify: Replay and verify the transcript, starting with low-confidence segments
planActions.recall: Recall key points and complete exercises before checking the source
planActions.record: Record again and compare matching and pace against a reference

desktopRequired: This is a browser preview. Open the Friday desktop app to upload, transcribe, and play local audio.
searchHint: Try another name or clear the search
uploadHint: Upload a recording to transcribe it and view analysis, a review plan, and exercises
startHint: Choose an engine and select Transcribe to create a timestamped transcript
resultsPending: Analysis and exercises will appear after transcription
correctionHint: Listen to the audio before correcting. Original recognition, timestamps and model confidence are preserved.
correctedAnalysisHint: Analysis and exercises use the corrected text. The match score does not measure original recognition accuracy.

errors.RECITATION_SESSION_BUSY: This audio is being processed. Correct it when processing finishes.
errors.RECITATION_TRANSCRIPT_CHANGED: The transcript has changed. Keep your draft and reopen the latest result before editing.
errors.RECITATION_CORRECTION_INVALID: Keep at least one nonempty passage and check the content length.
errors.RECITATION_AUDIO_MISSING: The managed audio copy is missing. Upload the recording again.
errors.MEDIA_TRANSCRIPTION_CHAT_ONLY: This chat model does not transcribe audio. Choose Windows speech or a compatible transcription model.
errors.MEDIA_TRANSCRIPTION_CANCELLED: Transcription was cancelled. You can start again.
errors.MEDIA_TRANSCRIPTION_TIMEOUT: Transcription timed out. Split the audio into shorter clips and retry.
errors.MEDIA_TRANSCRIPTION_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: No local speech recognition language pack was found. Install one or choose a compatible transcription model.
errors.MEDIA_TRANSCRIPTION_INVALID_AUDIO: This audio could not be decoded or recognized. Check the file and system codecs, or convert it to PCM WAV and retry.
errors.MEDIA_TRANSCRIPTION_SERVICE_FAILED: The transcription request failed. Check the endpoint, model and credentials, then retry.
errors.MEDIA_TRANSCRIPTION_RESULT_INVALID: The transcription endpoint returned an invalid result. Check its audio transcription compatibility.
errors.RECITATION_FAILED: Audio processing failed. Upload the recording again or choose another transcription engine and retry.

stages.generating-study: Generating review plan and source exercises…
